title: STRIDE: Strategy-to-Tactics Retrieval-Guided Skill Disclosure and Evolution for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.28907v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Skill-augmented reinforcement learning enables LLM agents to reuse task-solving knowledge across episodes, but existing systems typically expose agents to a flat skill pool and update skills only from coarse, episode-level outcomes. This conflates two distinct uses of experience: a stable strategy that should frame the whole episode, and tactical know-how that should be retrieved only when the agent reaches a local execution gap. We propose STRIDE (Strategy-to-Tactics Retrieval-guided skIll Disclosure and Evolution), a framework that brings progressive skill disclosure into agentic reinforcement learning. STRIDE keeps the selected strategy visible as episode context, exposes a compact tactic menu, and loads full tactic content only after an explicit retrieval action. This interface turns each retrieval into an event-level credit unit: the same event provides process feedback for learning when to retrieve and supplies evidence for skill-b

translated_title: STRIDE：面向智能体强化学习的策略到战术检索引导式技能披露与演化
translated_abstract: 技能增强的强化学习使LLM智能体能够在多个回合之间复用任务求解知识，但现有系统通常让智能体面对一个扁平化的技能池，并且仅依据粗粒度的回合级结果来更新技能。这混淆了经验的两种截然不同的用途：一种是应当贯穿整个回合的稳定策略，另一种是只有当智能体遇到局部执行缺口时才应检索的战术性技能知识。我们提出STRIDE（Strategy-to-Tactics Retrieval-guided skIll Disclosure and Evolution），一个将渐进式技能披露引入智能体强化学习的框架。STRIDE使所选策略作为回合上下文持续可见，呈现一个紧凑的战术菜单，并仅在显式检索动作之后才加载完整的战术内容。这一接口将每次检索转化为一个事件级的信用分配单元：同一事件既为学习何时检索提供过程反馈，又为技能演化提供证据。
tldr: STRIDE框架将技能分为贯穿全回合的稳定策略与局部按需检索的战术知识两个层次，通过渐进式技能披露机制（策略常驻上下文、战术菜单先呈现、完整内容按需加载），把每次检索转化为事件级信用单元，从而实现智能体强化学习中更精细的技能学习与演化。
